scripts.install-all: npm install -g pnpm && npm install && npm --prefix gateway install && npm --prefix services/auth install && npm --prefix services/project install && npm --prefix services/file install && npm --prefix services/ai install && npm --prefix services/terminal install && npm --prefix services/payment install
scripts.start: node --max-old-space-size=40 gateway/index.js & node --max-old-space-size=35 services/auth/index.js & node --max-old-space-size=35 services/project/index.js & node --max-old-space-size=35 services/file/index.js & node --max-old-space-size=95 services/ai/index.js & node --max-old-space-size=45 services/terminal/index.js & node --max-old-space-size=35 services/payment/index.js & wait
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,PROJ,FILE,AI,TERM,PAY" -c "cyan,blue,green,magenta,yellow,red,white" "npm --prefix gateway dev" "npm --prefix services/auth dev" "npm --prefix services/project dev" "npm --prefix services/file dev" "npm --prefix services/ai dev" "npm --prefix services/terminal dev" "npm --prefix services/payment dev"
